comment: The ladder of the flattening work. One case for each construct, in the order they are built. A case is done when reviews/<id>.md exists. README.md tells what each field means. The file of a declarative case, with its drawing and its probe values, is src/TestFiles/flattening/<id>.json on feature/flattening.

tolerance.comment: The tolerance of GATE-1 and GATE-2. The gates draw each process channel alone, without antialiasing. The session sets these numbers from the measurement of phase 1, and only @Pauli widens them. null: not set yet.

probeTolerance.comment: The tolerance of GATE-M on each CMYK value of a probe. OCAD's binary formats store steps of 0.005.

ladder.name: Two opaque marks of one colour overlap
ladder.adds: Nothing. The stage must give back what it was given.

ladder.name: An opaque colour over another
ladder.adds: The cut: the upper colour knocks the lower one out.

ladder.name: Two marks of one overprint ink overlap
ladder.adds: One coverage and not two. A mark raises the ink's coverage; it never adds to it.

ladder.name: Two overprint inks cross
ladder.adds: The inks compose by the blend mode: by multiply the product of their transmittances, by darken the darkest.

ladder.name: An overprint ink whose colours are not consecutive, an opaque colour between them
ladder.adds: The knockout of a mask that is not the top one. This is the case that task 7's layer cannot hold, and the case that task 14 waits for.
ladder.today: By multiply it differs where the two colours of the ink overlap with nothing between them (Model.md, D1). By darken it is the same.

ladder.name: A colour with an alpha below 1
ladder.adds: The opacity half of the work. LIM-3: no colour of an export has an alpha below 1 until fix/colour-transparency is merged, so the case sets the alpha in its file.
ladder.today: It differs where marks of one colour overlap (Model.md, D2).

ladder.name: Lines of a blended colour, and lines below one
ladder.adds: A stroked line becomes its outline before it cuts or is cut.

ladder.name: Hatchings and area patterns
ladder.adds: The geometry of a pattern drawn one time for a group of areas, as task 2 draws it.

ladder.name: Text of a blended colour, and text below one
A bitmap below a blended colour
ladder.adds: The limit that the stage reports instead of flattening.
ladder.today: Set apart (GATE-7): the stage leaves the drawing as it is.

ladder.name: The course's purple over a map, by darken and by multiply, and on the map's own colour levels
ladder.adds: The case a user sees. The colour levels with overprint ink do not exist before task 14.

ladder.name: The maps of the rendering tests
ladder.adds: All of it together, on real maps. Needs fix/colour-transparency for the three colours that carry a transparency: LordHill's Purple (t80), LordHill_ver16's Red (0.75) and McHugh Creek's Purple 40% (0.5).
